<USER>User story: "As a user, I want to log in with valid credentials so I can access my dashboard."
Category: authentication

<ASSISTANT>describe('User Login with Valid Credentials', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    cy.visit('/login');
  });

  it('should successfully log in with valid credentials and redirect to dashboard', () => {
    cy.intercept('POST', '/api/auth/login').as('loginRequest');
    
    cy.get('[data-testid="email-input"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="email-input"]').type('user@example.com');
    
    cy.get('[data-testid="password-input"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="password-input"]').type('ValidPassword123!');
    
    cy.get('[data-testid="login-button"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="login-button"]').click();
    
    cy.wait('@loginRequest').then((interception) => {
      expect(interception.response.statusCode).to.equal(200);
    });
    
    cy.url().should('include', '/dashboard');
    cy.get('[data-testid="welcome-message"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="welcome-message"]').should('contain', 'Welcome back');
    
    cy.get('[data-testid="user-profile-icon"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="logout-button"]').should('be.visible');
  });

  it('should display error message when login fails with invalid credentials', () => {
    cy.intercept('POST', '/api/auth/login', {
      statusCode: 401,
      body: { error: 'Invalid email or password' }
    }).as('failedLoginRequest');
    
    cy.get('[data-testid="email-input"]').type('user@example.com');
    cy.get('[data-testid="password-input"]').type('WrongPassword123!');
    
    cy.get('[data-testid="login-button"]').click();
    
    cy.wait('@failedLoginRequest');
    
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('contain', 'Invalid email or password');
    
    cy.url().should('include', '/login');
    cy.get('[data-testid="welcome-message"]').should('not.exist');
    
    cy.get('[data-testid="email-input"]').should('have.value', 'user@example.com');
    cy.get('[data-testid="password-input"]').should('have.value', 'WrongPassword123!');
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

<SYSTEM>You are a senior QA automation engineer specialising in Cypress. Given a Jira user story, generate a complete, production-quality Cypress test script. Return ONLY the raw Cypress JavaScript — no markdown fences, no explanations. Include describe(), beforeEach(), and at least 2 it() blocks (happy path + edge case).</SYSTEM>
<USER>User story: "As a user, I want to be redirected to login if I access a protected page unauthenticated."
Category: authentication
Complexity: complex
Return the script only.</USER>
<ASSISTANT>describe('Authentication - Protected Page Redirect', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    cy.visit('/dashboard');
  });

  it('should redirect unauthenticated user to login when accessing protected page', () => {
    // Clear all cookies and local storage to ensure unauthenticated state
    cy.clearCookies();
    cy.clearLocalStorage();

    // Attempt to visit protected dashboard page
    cy.visit('/dashboard', { failOnStatusCode: false });

    // Verify redirect to login page occurred
    cy.url().should('include', '/login');

    // Verify login form is visible
    cy.get('[data-testid="login-form"]').should('be.visible');

    // Verify login button exists and is enabled
    cy.get('[data-testid="login-button"]').should('be.visible').and('not.be.disabled');

    // Verify email input field is present
    cy.get('[data-testid="email-input"]').should('be.visible');

    // Verify password input field is present
    cy.get('[data-testid="password-input"]').should('be.visible');
  });

  it('should handle rapid redirect attempts and prevent infinite loops', () => {
    // Clear authentication state
    cy.clearCookies();
    cy.clearLocalStorage();

    // Setup API intercept for login page request
    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/auth/verify').as('verifyAuth');

    // Attempt to access protected resource multiple times
    cy.visit('/dashboard', { failOnStatusCode: false });
    cy.wait('@verifyAuth');

    // Verify we're on login page after first attempt
    cy.url().should('include', '/login');

    // Try accessing another protected page
    cy.visit('/profile', { failOnStatusCode: false });

    // Should still be on login, not in redirect loop
    cy.url().should('include', '/login');

    // Verify no error messages are shown
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('not.exist');

    // Verify login form is still functional
    cy.get('[data-testid="email-input"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="password-input"]').should('be.visible');

    // Attempt to fill login form to verify it's still interactive
    cy.get('[data-testid="email-input"]').type('test@example.com');
    cy.get('[data-testid="password-input"]').type('password123');

    // Verify form submission button is available
    cy.get('[data-testid="login-button"]').should('be.visible').and('not.be.disabled');
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

<ASSISTANT>describe('Remember Me Checkbox - Authentication', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    cy.visit('/login');
    cy.clearLocalStorage();
    cy.clearCookies();
  });

  it('should persist user session when Remember Me is checked', () => {
    // Fill login form
    cy.get('[data-testid="email-input"]').type('testuser@example.com');
    cy.get('[data-testid="password-input"]').type('securePassword123');
    
    // Check Remember Me checkbox

    });
    
    // Verify redirect to dashboard

    cy.get('[data-testid="welcome-message"]').should('be.visible');
    
    // Verify session token is stored
    cy.window().then((win) => {
      const sessionToken = win.localStorage.getItem('sessionToken');
      expect(sessionToken).to.exist;
    });
    
    // Close browser tab and revisit (simulate new session)

    cy.get('[data-testid="user-profile-menu"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="logout-button"]').should('be.visible');
  });

  it('should not persist session when Remember Me is unchecked', () => {

    cy.get('[data-testid="email-input"]').type('testuser@example.com');
    cy.get('[data-testid="password-input"]').type('securePassword123');
    
    // Verify Remember Me checkbox is unchecked by default

    // Submit login form
    cy.intercept('POST', '/api/auth/login').as('loginRequest');
    cy.get('[data-testid="login-button"]').click();
    cy.wait('@loginRequest').then((interception) => {
      expect(interception.request.body).to.not.include('rememberMe: true');
    });
    
    // Verify successful login
    cy.url().should('include', '/dashboard');
    cy.get('[data-testid="welcome-message"]').should('contain', 'Welcome');
    
    // Clear session storage to simulate browser close
    cy.clearLocalStorage();
    cy.clearCookies();
    
    // Attempt to visit dashboard without session
    cy.visit('/dashboard');
    
    // Should be redirected to login
    cy.url().should('include', '/login');
    cy.get('[data-testid="session-expired-message"]').should('be.visible');
  });

      req.reply((res) => {
        res.delay(2000);
        res.send({
          statusCode: 200,
          body: { token: 'abc123', userId: 'user1' },
        });
      });

    cy.get('[data-testid="email-input"]').type('user@example.com');

    cy.wait('@loginRequest');

    cy.get('[data-testid="loading-spinner"]').should('not.exist');
    cy.url().should('include', '/dashboard');
  });

  it('should hide spinner and display error message on failed login request', () => {
    cy.intercept('POST', '/api/auth/login', {
      statusCode: 401,
      body: { error: 'Invalid credentials' },
    }).as('failedLogin');

    cy.get('[data-testid="email-input"]').type('user@example.com');
    cy.get('[data-testid="password-input"]').type('wrongpassword');
    cy.get('[data-testid="login-button"]').click();

    cy.get('[data-testid="loading-spinner"]').should('be.visible');

    cy.wait('@failedLogin');

    cy.get('[data-testid="loading-spinner"]').should('not.exist');
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('be.visible');

    cy.url().should('include', '/login');
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

<ASSISTANT>describe('Account Lockout After 5 Failed Login Attempts', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    cy.visit('/login');
  });

  it('should lock account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts', () => {
    const testEmail = 'testuser@example.com';
    const wrongPassword = 'wrongpassword123';

    // Attempt 1
    cy.get('[data-testid="email-input"]').type(testEmail);
    cy.get('[data-testid="password-input"]').type(wrongPassword);
    cy.get('[data-testid="login-button"]').click();
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('contain', 'Invalid credentials');

    // Attempt 2
    cy.get('[data-testid="password-input"]').clear().type(wrongPassword);
    cy.get('[data-testid="login-button"]').click();
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('contain', 'Invalid credentials');

    // Attempt 3
    cy.get('[data-testid="password-input"]').clear().type(wrongPassword);
    cy.get('[data-testid="login-button"]').click();
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('contain', 'Invalid credentials');

    // Attempt 4
    cy.get('[data-testid="password-input"]').clear().type(wrongPassword);
    cy.get('[data-testid="login-button"]').click();
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('contain', 'Invalid credentials');

    // Attempt 5 - Should trigger account lockout
    cy.get('[data-testid="password-input"]').clear().type(wrongPassword);
    cy.intercept('POST', '/api/auth/login').as('fifthLoginAttempt');
    cy.get('[data-testid="login-button"]').click();
    cy.wait('@fifthLoginAttempt');
    cy.get('[data-testid="lockout-message"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="lockout-message"]').should('contain', 'Account locked');
    cy.get('[data-testid="login-button"]').should('be.disabled');
  });

  it('should prevent login with correct credentials when account is locked', () => {
    const testEmail = 'lockeduser@example.com';
    const correctPassword = 'correctpassword123';

    // Pre-condition: Account is already locked
    cy.intercept('POST', '/api/auth/login', {
      statusCode: 423,
      body: { error: 'Account is locked due to multiple failed login attempts' }
    }).as('loginWithLockedAccount');

    cy.get('[data-testid="email-input"]').type(testEmail);
    cy.get('[data-testid="password-input"]').type(correctPassword);
    cy.get('[data-testid="login-button"]').click();
    cy.wait('@loginWithLockedAccount');
    
    cy.get('[data-testid="account-locked-banner"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="account-locked-banner"]').should('contain', 'locked');
    cy.get('[data-testid="unlock-instructions"]').should('contain', 'contact support');
    cy.get('[data-testid="login-button"]').should('be.disabled');
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/user/profile', (req) => {

      expect(secondLoadTime).to.be.lessThan(100);
    });

  it('should invalidate cache when refresh is triggered or cache expires', () => {

    // Simulate cache expiration timeout
    cy.clock();
    cy.tick(3600000); // 1 hour expiration
    
    // Next request should bypass cache

    cy.get('[data-testid="load-profile-btn"]').click();

<ASSISTANT>describe('Stale Record Conflict Error Handling', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    cy.visit('/records');
  });

  it('should display conflict error message when saving a stale record', () => {
    // Setup: intercept the initial GET request for a record
    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/records/123').as('getRecord');
    
    // Open a record
    cy.get('[data-testid="record-item-123"]').click();
    cy.wait('@getRecord');
    
    // Setup: intercept the PUT request with a conflict response
    cy.intercept('PUT', '/api/records/123', {
      statusCode: 409,
      body: {
        error: 'Conflict: Record has been modified by another user',
        currentVersion: 2,
        yourVersion: 1
      }
    }).as('updateRecord');
    
    // User modifies a field
    cy.get('[data-testid="record-name-input"]').click().clear().type('Updated Name');
    
    // User attempts to save
    cy.get('[data-testid="save-button"]').click();
    cy.wait('@updateRecord');
    
    // Verify conflict error message is displayed
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]')
      .should('be.visible')
      .should('contain', 'Conflict: Record has been modified by another user');
    
    // Verify error contains version information
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-details"]')
      .should('contain', 'yourVersion: 1')
      .should('contain', 'currentVersion: 2');
    
    // Verify save button is disabled after error
    cy.get('[data-testid="save-button"]').should('be.disabled');
  });

  it('should handle successful save after resolving conflict', () => {
    // Setup: intercept initial GET
    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/records/456').as('getRecord');
    
    cy.get('[data-testid="record-item-456"]').click();
    cy.wait('@getRecord');
    
    // First save attempt fails with 409
    cy.intercept('PUT', '/api/records/456', (req) => {
      req.reply({
        statusCode: 409,
        body: {
          error: 'Conflict: Record has been modified',
          currentVersion: 3
        }
      });
    }).as('conflictUpdate');
    
    cy.get('[data-testid="record-description-input"]').click().clear().type('New Description');
    cy.get('[data-testid="save-button"]').click();
    cy.wait('@conflictUpdate');
    
    // Verify error message appears
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('be.visible');
    
    // User clicks resolve/refresh button
    cy.get('[data-testid="reload-button"]').click();
    
    // Second GET to fetch latest version
    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/records/456').as('reloadRecord');
    cy.wait('@reloadRecord');
    
    // Second save attempt succeeds with 200
    cy.intercept('PUT', '/api/records/456', {
      statusCode: 200,
      body: { id: 456, version: 4, message: 'Record saved successfully' }
    }).as('successUpdate');
    
    cy.get('[data-testid="save-button"]').click();
    cy.wait('@successUpdate');
    
    // Verify success message
    cy.get('[data-testid="success-message"]')
      .should('be.visible')
      .should('contain', 'Record saved successfully');
    
    // Verify error message is cleared
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('not.exist');
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

  it('should successfully edit a table row inline without opening a modal', () => {
    // Intercept API call for row update
    cy.intercept('PATCH', '/api/rows/*').as('updateRow');

    // Locate and click the edit button on the first row
    cy.get('[data-testid="row-1"]').within(() => {

    // Verify API was called

      expect(interception.request.body).to.deep.equal({

    cy.get('[data-testid="success-toast"]').should('be.visible').should('contain', 'Row updated successfully');

    cy.get('[data-testid="row-2-name-cell"]').then(($cell) => {
      const originalName = $cell.text();
      expect(originalName).to.equal('Jane Doe');
    });

    // Click edit button on second row
    cy.get('[data-testid="row-2"]').within(() => {
      cy.get('[data-testid="edit-btn"]').click();
    });

    // Modify the name field
    cy.get('[data-testid="row-2-name-input"]').clear().type('Jane Modified');

    // Click cancel button
    cy.get('[data-testid="row-2-cancel-btn"]').click();

    // Verify edit mode is exited without saving
    cy.get('[data-testid="row-2-name-input"]').should('not.exist');

    // Verify original value is preserved
    cy.get('[data-testid="row-2-name-cell"]').should('contain', 'Jane Doe');

    // Verify no success message appears
    cy.get('[data-testid="success-toast"]').should('not.exist');

<ASSISTANT>describe('Reorder List Items by Drag and Drop', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    cy.visit('/list-items');
  });

  it('should successfully reorder list items by dragging and dropping', () => {
    // Verify initial list order
    cy.get('[data-testid="list-item"]').should('have.length', 3);
    cy.get('[data-testid="list-item"]').eq(0).should('contain', 'Item 1');
    cy.get('[data-testid="list-item"]').eq(1).should('contain', 'Item 2');
    cy.get('[data-testid="list-item"]').eq(2).should('contain', 'Item 3');

    cy.get('[data-testid="list-item-drag-handle"]').eq(2).trigger('mousedown', { button: 0 });
    cy.get('[data-testid="list-item"]').eq(0).trigger('dragover');
    cy.get('[data-testid="list-item"]').eq(0).trigger('drop');
    cy.get('[data-testid="list-item-drag-handle"]').eq(2).trigger('mouseup');

    // Wait for API response
    cy.wait('@reorderRequest').its('response.statusCode').should('equal', 200);

    // Verify new order
    cy.get('[data-testid="list-item"]').eq(0).should('contain', 'Item 3');
    cy.get('[data-testid="list-item"]').eq(1).should('contain', 'Item 1');
    cy.get('[data-testid="list-item"]').eq(2).should('contain', 'Item 2');

    // Verify success message
    cy.get('[data-testid="success-message"]').should('be.visible').should('contain', 'List reordered successfully');

  it('should not allow dragging when list is empty or single item exists', () => {

    cy.get('[data-testid="empty-list-option"]').click();

    // Navigate to single item list
    cy.get('[data-testid="list-selector"]').click();
    cy.get('[data-testid="single-item-list-option"]').click();

    // Verify only one item exists
    cy.get('[data-testid="list-item"]').should('have.length', 1);

    // Attempt to drag (should fail or be disabled)
    cy.get('[data-testid="list-item-drag-handle"]').should('be.disabled');

    // Verify no reorder API call was made
    cy.intercept('POST', '/api/lists/reorder').as('reorderAttempt');
    cy.get('[data-testid="list-item-drag-handle"]').trigger('mousedown');
    cy.get('[data-testid="list-item"]').trigger('drop');
    cy.get('@reorderAttempt.all').should('have.length', 0);
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

<USER>User story: "As a user, I want to see a rate-limit error if I submit a form too many times."
Category: error_states
Complexity: complex
Return the script only.</USER>
<ASSISTANT>describe('Rate Limit Error on Form Submission', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    cy.visit('/contact-form');
  });

  it('should display rate-limit error after exceeding submission threshold', () => {
    // Mock API to track submission count
    let submissionCount = 0;
    cy.intercept('POST', '/api/contact', (req) => {
      submissionCount++;
      if (submissionCount > 5) {
        req.reply({
          statusCode: 429,
          body: {
            error: 'Too Many Requests',
            message: 'Rate limit exceeded. Please try again in 60 seconds.',
            retryAfter: 60
          }
        });
      } else {
        req.reply({
          statusCode: 200,
          body: { success: true, message: 'Form submitted successfully' }
        });
      }
    }).as('submitForm');

    // Fill and submit form 6 times
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      cy.get('[data-testid="name-input"]').clear().type(`User ${i}`);
      cy.get('[data-testid="email-input"]').clear().type(`user${i}@example.com`);
      cy.get('[data-testid="submit-btn"]').click();
      cy.wait('@submitForm');

      if (i < 5) {
        // First 5 submissions succeed
        cy.get('[data-testid="success-message"]').should('be.visible').should('contain', 'submitted successfully');
      } else {
        // 6th submission triggers rate limit
        cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('be.visible');
        cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('contain', 'Rate limit exceeded');
        cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('contain', 'try again in 60 seconds');
      }
    }

    // Verify submit button is disabled after rate limit
    cy.get('[data-testid="submit-btn"]').should('be.disabled');
  });

  it('should handle 429 error gracefully with retry countdown', () => {
    cy.intercept('POST', '/api/contact', {
      statusCode: 429,
      body: {
        error: 'Too Many Requests',
        message: 'Rate limit exceeded. Please try again in 60 seconds.',
        retryAfter: 60
      }
    }).as('rateLimitedRequest');

    cy.get('[data-testid="name-input"]').type('John Doe');
    cy.get('[data-testid="email-input"]').type('john@example.com');
    cy.get('[data-testid="submit-btn"]').click();
    cy.wait('@rateLimitedRequest');

    // Verify error message is displayed
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('contain', 'Too Many Requests');

    // Verify retry timer is shown
    cy.get('[data-testid="retry-timer"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="retry-timer"]').should('contain', '60');

    // Verify submit button is disabled during cooldown
    cy.get('[data-testid="submit-btn"]').should('be.disabled');

    // Verify error styling is applied
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-container"]').should('have.class', 'error-state');
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

<ASSISTANT>describe('Background Job Toast Notification', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    cy.visit('/jobs');
  });

  it('should display a success toast when background job completes', () => {
    // Setup intercept for the job completion API
    cy.intercept('POST', '/api/jobs/start', {
      statusCode: 200,
      body: { jobId: 'job-123', status: 'processing' }
    }).as('startJob');

    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/jobs/job-123/status', {
      statusCode: 200,
      body: { jobId: 'job-123', status: 'completed', message: 'Job completed successfully' }
    }).as('jobCompleted');

    // Click the button to start the job
    cy.get('[data-testid="start-job-button"]').click();
    cy.wait('@startJob');

    // Wait for the job completion API call
    cy.wait('@jobCompleted');

    // Verify the toast notification appears with success message
    cy.get('[data-testid="toast-notification"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="toast-notification"]').should('contain', 'Job completed successfully');
    cy.get('[data-testid="toast-icon"]').should('have.class', 'success-icon');

    // Verify toast auto-dismisses after 3 seconds
    cy.get('[data-testid="toast-notification"]', { timeout: 4000 }).should('not.exist');
  });

  it('should display an error toast when background job fails', () => {
    // Setup intercept for the job completion API with error
    cy.intercept('POST', '/api/jobs/start', {
      statusCode: 200,
      body: { jobId: 'job-456', status: 'processing' }
    }).as('startJob');

    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/jobs/job-456/status', {
      statusCode: 200,
      body: { jobId: 'job-456', status: 'failed', message: 'Job failed: Database connection error' }
    }).as('jobFailed');

    // Click the button to start the job
    cy.get('[data-testid="start-job-button"]').click();
    cy.wait('@startJob');

    // Wait for the job failure API call
    cy.wait('@jobFailed');

    // Verify the error toast notification appears
    cy.get('[data-testid="toast-notification"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="toast-notification"]').should('contain', 'Job failed: Database connection error');
    cy.get('[data-testid="toast-icon"]').should('have.class', 'error-icon');

    // Verify close button exists and works
    cy.get('[data-testid="toast-close-button"]').should('be.visible').click();
    cy.get('[data-testid="toast-notification"]').should('not.exist');
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

<USER>User story: "As a user, I want lazy-loaded components to appear smoothly without layout shift."
Category: async_await
Complexity: medium
Return the script only.</USER>
<ASSISTANT>describe('Lazy-loaded components appear smoothly without layout shift', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    cy.visit('/components');
    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/lazy-components').as('lazyComponentsLoad');
  });

  it('should load lazy components smoothly with proper spacing', () => {
    // Get initial viewport dimensions
    cy.viewport(1280, 720);
    
    // Scroll to trigger lazy load
    cy.get('[data-testid="lazy-component-container"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="scroll-trigger"]').scrollIntoView();
    
    // Wait for API call to complete
    cy.wait('@lazyComponentsLoad');
    
    // Verify lazy-loaded content appears without CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift)
    cy.get('[data-testid="lazy-card-1"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="lazy-card-2"]').should('be.visible');
    
    // Verify content has proper dimensions (no layout shift)
    cy.get('[data-testid="lazy-card-1"]').then(($card) => {
      const height = $card.height();
      expect(height).to.be.greaterThan(100);
      expect(height).to.be.lessThan(500);
    });
    
    // Verify placeholder is removed after content loads
    cy.get('[data-testid="lazy-skeleton"]').should('not.exist');
    
    // Verify animation class is applied for smooth appearance
    cy.get('[data-testid="lazy-card-1"]').should('have.class', 'fade-in-smooth');
    
    // Verify text content loads correctly
    cy.get('[data-testid="lazy-card-1"]').should('contain', 'Loaded Content');
  });

  it('should handle lazy load failure gracefully with fallback UI', () => {
    // Intercept API call with error response
    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/lazy-components', { 
      statusCode: 500,
      body: { error: 'Server error' }
    }).as('lazyComponentsError');
    
    // Scroll to trigger lazy load
    cy.get('[data-testid="scroll-trigger"]').scrollIntoView();
    
    // Wait for failed API call
    cy.wait('@lazyComponentsError');
    
    // Verify error state is displayed instead of layout shift
    cy.get('[data-testid="lazy-error-message"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="lazy-error-message"]').should('contain', 'Failed to load');
    
    // Verify skeleton loaders are removed
    cy.get('[data-testid="lazy-skeleton"]').should('not.exist');
    
    // Verify retry button is available
    cy.get('[data-testid="retry-button"]').should('be.visible');
    
    // Verify container maintains proper height to prevent shift
    cy.get('[data-testid="lazy-component-container"]').then(($container) => {
      const containerHeight = $container.height();
      expect(containerHeight).to.be.greaterThan(0);
    });
    
    // Click retry button
    cy.get('[data-testid="retry-button"]').click();
    
    // Verify retry is attempted
    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/lazy-components', { 
      statusCode: 200,
      body: { components: [{ id: 1, title: 'Retry Success' }] }
    }).as('lazyComponentsRetry');
    
    cy.wait('@lazyComponentsRetry');
    cy.get('[data-testid="lazy-card-1"]').should('contain', 'Retry Success');
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

text:
<SYSTEM>You are a senior QA automation engineer specialising in Cypress. Given a Jira user story, generate a complete, production-quality Cypress test script. Return ONLY the raw Cypress JavaScript — no markdown fences, no explanations. Include describe(), beforeEach(), and at least 2 it() blocks (happy path + edge case).</SYSTEM>
<USER>User story: "As a user, I want debounced search to trigger only after I stop typing for 300ms."
Category: async_await
Complexity: complex
Return the script only.</USER>
<ASSISTANT>describe('Debounced Search Functionality', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    cy.visit('/search');
  });

  it('should trigger search API call only after user stops typing for 300ms', () => {
    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/search*').as('searchRequest');
    
    const searchInput = cy.get('[data-testid="search-input"]');
    
    // Type characters with delays less than 300ms
    searchInput.type('t', { delay: 50 });
    cy.wait(50);
    searchInput.type('e', { delay: 50 });
    cy.wait(50);
    searchInput.type('s', { delay: 50 });
    cy.wait(50);
    searchInput.type('t', { delay: 50 });
    
    // Verify no API call has been made yet
    cy.get('@searchRequest.all').then(interceptions => {
      expect(interceptions).to.have.lengthOf(0);
    });
    
    // Wait for 300ms debounce timeout to elapse
    cy.wait(350);
    
    // Now the API call should have been triggered
    cy.wait('@searchRequest').then(interception => {
      expect(interception.request.url).to.include('q=test');
    });
    
    // Verify search results are displayed
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-results"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-result-item"]').should('have.length.greaterThan', 0);
  });

  it('should handle rapid consecutive searches and debounce correctly', () => {
    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/search*').as('searchRequest');
    
    const searchInput = cy.get('[data-testid="search-input"]');
    
    // First search: type and wait for debounce
    searchInput.type('first', { delay: 50 });
    cy.wait(350);
    cy.wait('@searchRequest').then(interception => {
      expect(interception.request.url).to.include('q=first');
    });
    
    // Clear and type second search immediately
    searchInput.clear();
    searchInput.type('second', { delay: 50 });
    
    // Type more characters before debounce completes
    cy.wait(150);
    searchInput.type('query', { delay: 50 });
    
    // Should not have triggered another search yet
    cy.get('@searchRequest.all').then(interceptions => {
      expect(interceptions).to.have.lengthOf(1);
    });
    
    // Wait for debounce
    cy.wait(350);
    
    // Now second search should be triggered
    cy.wait('@searchRequest').then(interception => {
      expect(interception.request.url).to.include('q=secondquery');
    });
    
    // Verify loading state is no longer visible
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-loading"]').should('not.exist');
    
    // Verify results are shown
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-results"]').should('be.visible');
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

user_story: As a user, I want race conditions in search to be handled so only the latest result shows.
text:
<SYSTEM>You are a senior QA automation engineer specialising in Cypress. Given a Jira user story, generate a complete, production-quality Cypress test script. Return ONLY the raw Cypress JavaScript — no markdown fences, no explanations. Include describe(), beforeEach(), and at least 2 it() blocks (happy path + edge case).</SYSTEM>
<USER>User story: "As a user, I want race conditions in search to be handled so only the latest result shows."
Category: async_await
Complexity: medium
Return the script only.</USER>
<ASSISTANT>describe('Search Race Condition Handling', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    cy.visit('/search');
  });

  it('should display only the latest search result when multiple requests are in flight', () => {
    // Setup: intercept search API calls with delays to simulate race conditions
    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/search?q=*', (req) => {
      const query = new URL(req.url).searchParams.get('q');
      if (query === 'old') {
        req.reply((res) => {
          res.delay = 2000; // Simulate slow response
          res.send({
            statusCode: 200,
            body: { results: [{ id: 1, title: 'Old Search Result' }] }
          });
        });
      } else if (query === 'new') {
        req.reply((res) => {
          res.delay = 500; // Faster response
          res.send({
            statusCode: 200,
            body: { results: [{ id: 2, title: 'New Search Result' }] }
          });
        });
      }
    }).as('searchRequest');

    // User performs rapid searches
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-input"]').type('old', { delay: 100 });
    cy.wait('@searchRequest');
    
    // Immediately search for new term before first response completes
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-input"]').clear().type('new', { delay: 100 });
    cy.wait('@searchRequest');

    // Verify only the latest (new) result is displayed
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-results"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-result-item"]').should('have.length', 1);
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-result-item"]').should('contain', 'New Search Result');
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-result-item"]').should('not.contain', 'Old Search Result');
  });

  it('should handle stale results gracefully when search is cancelled before completion', () => {
    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/search?q=*', (req) => {
      req.reply((res) => {
        res.delay = 3000; // Very slow response
        res.send({
          statusCode: 200,
          body: { results: [{ id: 3, title: 'Stale Result' }] }
        });
      });
    }).as('slowSearch');

    // User starts typing
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-input"]').type('slo', { delay: 200 });
    
    // User changes their mind and clears the search
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-input"]').clear();
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-clear-btn"]').click();

    // Wait a moment then verify no stale results appear
    cy.wait(500);
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-results"]').should('not.exist');
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-result-item"]').should('not.exist');
    cy.get('[data-testid="empty-state"]').should('be.visible').should('contain', 'Start typing to search');
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

<ASSISTANT>describe('Checkout Flow - Sequential Async Steps', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    cy.visit('/checkout');

  it('should complete checkout with sequential async steps in correct order', () => {
    // Step 1: Add item to cart (async operation)
    cy.get('[data-testid="add-to-cart-btn"]').click();
    cy.intercept('POST', '/api/cart/items').as('addToCart');
    cy.wait('@addToCart');
    cy.get('[data-testid="cart-count"]').should('contain', '1');

    // Step 2: Proceed to shipping (async operation)
    cy.get('[data-testid="proceed-to-shipping-btn"]').click();
    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/shipping/rates').as('fetchShippingRates');
    cy.wait('@fetchShippingRates');
    cy.get('[data-testid="shipping-options"]').should('be.visible');

    // Step 3: Select shipping option (async operation)
    cy.get('[data-testid="shipping-option-standard"]').click();
    cy.intercept('POST', '/api/shipping/select').as('selectShipping');
    cy.wait('@selectShipping');
    cy.get('[data-testid="shipping-confirmation"]').should('contain', 'Standard Shipping');

    // Step 4: Enter billing address (async validation)
    cy.get('[data-testid="billing-address-input"]').type('123 Main St, Springfield, IL 62701');
    cy.get('[data-testid="billing-zip"]').type('62701');
    cy.intercept('POST', '/api/billing/validate').as('validateBilling');
    cy.get('[data-testid="validate-address-btn"]').click();
    cy.wait('@validateBilling');
    cy.get('[data-testid="address-valid-badge"]').should('be.visible');

    // Step 5: Enter payment information (async operation)
    cy.get('[data-testid="card-number-input"]').type('4111111111111111');
    cy.get('[data-testid="card-expiry"]').type('12/25');
    cy.get('[data-testid="card-cvv"]').type('123');
    cy.intercept('POST', '/api/payment/process').as('processPayment');
    cy.get('[data-testid="place-order-btn"]').click();
    cy.wait('@processPayment');

    // Step 6: Verify order confirmation (final async step)
    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/orders/latest').as('fetchOrderConfirmation');
    cy.wait('@fetchOrderConfirmation');
    cy.get('[data-testid="order-confirmation-header"]').should('contain', 'Order Placed Successfully');
    cy.get('[data-testid="order-number"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="estimated-delivery"]').should('be.visible');
  });

  it('should handle async step failure and prevent progression to next step', () => {
    // Step 1: Add item to cart succeeds
    cy.get('[data-testid="add-to-cart-btn"]').click();
    cy.intercept('POST', '/api/cart/items').as('addToCart');
    cy.wait('@addToCart');
    cy.get('[data-testid="cart-count"]').should('contain', '1');

    // Step 2: Proceed to shipping
    cy.get('[data-testid="proceed-to-shipping-btn"]').click();
    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/shipping/rates', { statusCode: 500 }).as('fetchShippingRatesFail');
    cy.wait('@fetchShippingRatesFail');

    // Step 3: Verify error message appears and user cannot proceed
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-banner"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-banner"]').should('contain', 'Unable to load shipping options');

    // Step 4: Retry button should be available
    cy.get('[data-testid="retry-shipping-btn"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="proceed-to-payment-btn"]').should('be.disabled');

    // Step 5: Attempt to retry and succeed

    cy.get('[data-testid="retry-shipping-btn"]').click();
    cy.wait('@fetchShippingRatesRetry');

text:
<SYSTEM>You are a senior QA automation engineer specialising in Cypress. Given a Jira user story, generate a complete, production-quality Cypress test script. Return ONLY the raw Cypress JavaScript — no markdown fences, no explanations. Include describe(), beforeEach(), and at least 2 it() blocks (happy path + edge case).</SYSTEM>
<USER>User story: "As a user, I want a WebSocket connection to update the UI in real-time."
Category: async_await
Complexity: medium
Return the script only.</USER>
<ASSISTANT>describe('WebSocket Real-Time UI Updates', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    cy.visit('/websocket-dashboard');
  });

  it('should establish WebSocket connection and update UI with real-time data', () => {
    // Intercept WebSocket upgrade handshake
    cy.intercept('GET', '**/ws', {
      statusCode: 101,
      headers: {
        'upgrade': 'websocket',
        'connection': 'upgrade'
      }
    }).as('websocketConnection');

    // Verify initial state before connection
    cy.get('[data-testid="connection-status"]').should('contain', 'Connecting...');
    cy.get('[data-testid="data-feed"]').should('be.visible');

    // Trigger WebSocket connection
    cy.get('[data-testid="connect-button"]').click();

    // Wait for connection to establish
    cy.wait('@websocketConnection', { timeout: 5000 });

    // Verify connection established
    cy.get('[data-testid="connection-status"]').should('contain', 'Connected');
    cy.get('[data-testid="status-indicator"]').should('have.css', 'background-color', 'rgb(34, 197, 94)');

    // Simulate incoming WebSocket messages via cy.window()
    cy.window().then((win) => {
      const mockMessage = {
        type: 'data_update',
        payload: { value: 42, timestamp: Date.now() }
      };
      win.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('websocket:message', { detail: mockMessage }));
    });

    // Verify UI updates with new data
    cy.get('[data-testid="data-value"]').should('contain', '42');
    cy.get('[data-testid="last-update-time"]').should('not.be.empty');
    cy.get('[data-testid="message-count"]').should('contain', '1');
  });

  it('should handle WebSocket connection failure and display error state', () => {
    // Intercept failed WebSocket connection
    cy.intercept('GET', '**/ws', {
      statusCode: 503,
      body: { error: 'Service Unavailable' }
    }).as('websocketFailure');

    cy.get('[data-testid="connect-button"]').click();

    // Wait for connection attempt
    cy.wait('@websocketFailure', { timeout: 5000 });

    // Verify error state
    cy.get('[data-testid="connection-status"]').should('contain', 'Connection Failed');
    cy.get('[data-testid="status-indicator"]').should('have.css', 'background-color', 'rgb(239, 68, 68)');
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('contain', 'Failed to connect');

    // Verify retry button appears
    cy.get('[data-testid="retry-button"]').should('be.visible');

    // Verify data feed is disabled during error
    cy.get('[data-testid="data-feed"]').should('be.disabled');

<ASSISTANT>describe('Async Error Retry Functionality', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    cy.visit('/async-operations');
  });

  it('should display retry option when async operation fails', () => {
    // Intercept the initial async request and simulate failure
    cy.intercept('POST', '/api/async-operation', {
      statusCode: 500,
      body: { error: 'Server error' }
    }).as('asyncFailure');

    // Click button to trigger async operation
    cy.get('[data-testid="async-operation-btn"]').click();

    // Wait for the failed request
    cy.wait('@asyncFailure');

    // Verify error message is displayed
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]')
      .should('be.visible')
      .should('contain', 'Operation failed');

    // Verify retry button is visible
    cy.get('[data-testid="retry-btn"]')
      .should('be.visible')
      .should('contain', 'Retry');

    // Now intercept the retry request with success
    cy.intercept('POST', '/api/async-operation', {
      statusCode: 200,
      body: { success: true, data: 'Operation completed' }
    }).as('asyncSuccess');

    // Click retry button
    cy.get('[data-testid="retry-btn"]').click();

    // Wait for successful request
    cy.wait('@asyncSuccess');

    // Verify success message is displayed
    cy.get('[data-testid="success-message"]')
      .should('be.visible')
      .should('contain', 'Operation completed successfully');

    // Verify error and retry button are no longer visible
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('not.exist');
    cy.get('[data-testid="retry-btn"]').should('not.exist');
  });

  it('should handle multiple retry failures with increasing backoff', () => {
    let requestCount = 0;

    // Intercept requests and fail first two attempts
    cy.intercept('POST', '/api/async-operation', (req) => {
      requestCount++;
      if (requestCount < 3) {
        req.reply({
          statusCode: 503,
          body: { error: 'Service temporarily unavailable' }
        });
      } else {
        req.reply({
          statusCode: 200,
          body: { success: true, data: 'Finally succeeded' }
        });
      }
    }).as('asyncWithRetries');

    // Trigger initial operation
    cy.get('[data-testid="async-operation-btn"]').click();
    cy.wait('@asyncWithRetries');

    // Verify first failure
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]')
      .should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="retry-btn"]')
      .should('be.visible');

    // First retry
    cy.get('[data-testid="retry-btn"]').click();
    cy.wait('@asyncWithRetries');

    // Verify second failure still shows retry option
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]')
      .should('be.visible')
      .should('contain', 'Service temporarily unavailable');
    cy.get('[data-testid="retry-btn"]')
      .should('be.visible');

    // Second retry succeeds
    cy.get('[data-testid="retry-btn"]').click();
    cy.wait('@asyncWithRetries');

    // Verify final success
    cy.get('[data-testid="success-message"]')
      .should('be.visible')
      .should('contain', 'Finally succeeded');
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('not.exist');
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

<ASSISTANT>describe('Table Loading State', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    cy.visit('/table-list');
  });

  it('should display loading state while data is fetching', () => {
    // Intercept the API call to simulate loading delay
    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/data', (req) => {
      req.reply((res) => {
        res.delay(2000);
        res.send({
          statusCode: 200,
          body: {
            items: [
              { id: 1, name: 'Item 1', status: 'active' },
              { id: 2, name: 'Item 2', status: 'inactive' },
              { id: 3, name: 'Item 3', status: 'active' }
            ]
          }
        });
      });
    }).as('fetchTableData');

    // Trigger the data fetch
    cy.get('[data-testid="refresh-button"]').click();

    // Verify loading state is visible
    cy.get('[data-testid="loading-spinner"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="loading-text"]').should('contain', 'Loading data...');

    // Verify table rows are not yet visible during loading
    cy.get('[data-testid="table-row"]').should('not.exist');

    // Wait for API response
    cy.wait('@fetchTableData');

    // Verify loading state disappears
    cy.get('[data-testid="loading-spinner"]').should('not.exist');
    cy.get('[data-testid="loading-text"]').should('not.exist');

    // Verify table data is now visible
    cy.get('[data-testid="table-row"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="table-row"]').should('have.length', 3);
    cy.get('[data-testid="table-cell-name"]').first().should('contain', 'Item 1');
  });

  it('should handle loading state when API request fails', () => {
    // Intercept the API call to simulate error
    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/data', {
      statusCode: 500,
      body: { error: 'Internal Server Error' }
    }).as('fetchTableDataError');

    // Trigger the data fetch
    cy.get('[data-testid="refresh-button"]').click();

    // Verify loading state is visible
    cy.get('[data-testid="loading-spinner"]').should('be.visible');

    // Wait for API response
    cy.wait('@fetchTableDataError');

    // Verify loading state disappears
    cy.get('[data-testid="loading-spinner"]').should('not.exist');

    // Verify error message is displayed
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('contain', 'Failed to load data');

    // Verify table is empty or shows fallback state
    cy.get('[data-testid="table-row"]').should('not.exist');
    cy.get('[data-testid="empty-state"]').should('be.visible');
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

<ASSISTANT>describe('Virtual Scroll List - 10,000 Rows Performance', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    cy.visit('/virtual-scroll-list');
  });

  it('Happy Path: Should render virtual scroll list with 10,000 rows without lag', () => {
    // Verify the list container is visible
    cy.get('[data-testid="virtual-scroll-container"]').should('be.visible');

    // Verify initial rows are rendered
    cy.get('[data-testid="list-row"]').should('have.length.greaterThan', 0);

    // Intercept API call to fetch initial data
    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/rows?limit=50&offset=0').as('fetchInitialRows');

    // Scroll down to middle of list
    cy.get('[data-testid="virtual-scroll-container"]').scrollTo('center');

    // Intercept API call for paginated data
    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/rows?limit=50&offset=*').as('fetchPaginatedRows');
    cy.wait('@fetchPaginatedRows', { timeout: 5000 });

    // Verify rows are still rendered without lag
    cy.get('[data-testid="list-row"]').should('have.length.greaterThan', 0);

    // Scroll to bottom
    cy.get('[data-testid="virtual-scroll-container"]').scrollTo('bottom');
    cy.wait('@fetchPaginatedRows', { timeout: 5000 });

    // Verify final rows are rendered
    cy.get('[data-testid="list-row"]').last().should('be.visible');

    // Verify row count indicator shows correct total
    cy.get('[data-testid="total-rows-count"]').should('contain', '10000');

    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('not.exist');
  });

  it('Negative Path: Should handle scroll performance degradation and display error gracefully', () => {
    // Verify the list container is visible
    cy.get('[data-testid="virtual-scroll-container"]').should('be.visible');

    // Simulate API timeout/failure
    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/rows?limit=50&offset=*', {
      delay: 10000,
      statusCode: 500,
      body: { error: 'Server error' }
    }).as('failedFetch');

    // Attempt to scroll
    cy.get('[data-testid="virtual-scroll-container"]').scrollTo('center');
    cy.wait('@failedFetch', { timeout: 12000 });

    // Verify error message is displayed
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('contain', 'Unable to load data');

    // Verify retry button is available
    cy.get('[data-testid="retry-button"]').should('be.visible').click();

    // Intercept successful retry
    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/rows?limit=50&offset=*').as('retryFetch');
    cy.wait('@retryFetch', { timeout: 5000 });

    // Verify error message is cleared
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('not.exist');

    // Verify list is restored
    cy.get('[data-testid="list-row"]').should('have.length.greaterThan', 0);
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

Return ONLY the raw Cypress JavaScript — no markdown fences, no explanations. Include describe(), beforeEach(), and at least 2 it() blocks (happy path + edge case).</SYSTEM>
<USER>User story: "As a user, I want to share a filtered search URL with someone else."
Category: search_filter
Complexity: complex
Return the script only.</USER>
<ASSISTANT>describe('Share Filtered Search URL', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    cy.visit('/search');
  });

  it('should successfully generate and copy a shareable filtered search URL', () => {
    // Apply filters
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-input"]').type('javascript');
    cy.get('[data-testid="filter-category"]').click();
    cy.get('[data-testid="category-option-development"]').click();
    cy.get('[data-testid="filter-date-range"]').click();
    cy.get('[data-testid="date-from-input"]').type('2024-01-01');
    cy.get('[data-testid="date-to-input"]').type('2024-12-31');
    cy.get('[data-testid="apply-filters-btn"]').click();

    // Verify search results are displayed with filters applied
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-results"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="result-item"]').should('have.length.greaterThan', 0);

    // Open share menu
    cy.get('[data-testid="share-button"]').click();
    cy.get('[data-testid="share-menu"]').should('be.visible');

    // Copy share URL
    cy.get('[data-testid="copy-url-button"]').click();
    cy.get('[data-testid="share-menu"]').should('contain', 'URL copied to clipboard');

    // Verify URL contains filter parameters
    cy.window().then((win) => {
      expect(win.location.search).to.include('q=javascript');
      expect(win.location.search).to.include('category=development');
      expect(win.location.search).to.include('from=2024-01-01');
      expect(win.location.search).to.include('to=2024-12-31');
    });
  });

  it('should handle sharing with no filters applied as edge case', () => {
    // Navigate to search without applying any filters
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-input"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-results"]').should('not.exist');

    // Open share menu without filters
    cy.get('[data-testid="share-button"]').click();
    cy.get('[data-testid="share-menu"]').should('be.visible');

    // Verify warning message appears
    cy.get('[data-testid="share-menu"]').should('contain', 'No filters applied');

    // Copy unfiltered URL
    cy.get('[data-testid="copy-url-button"]').click();

    // Verify base URL is copied without parameters
    cy.window().then((win) => {
      expect(win.location.search).to.equal('');
    });

    // Close share menu
    cy.get('[data-testid="close-share-menu"]').click();
    cy.get('[data-testid="share-menu"]').should('not.exist');
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

<ASSISTANT>describe('Search Input Focus on Slash Keyboard Shortcut', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    cy.visit('/search');
  });

  it('should focus the search input when "/" key is pressed', () => {
    // Verify search input exists and is not focused initially
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-input"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-input"]').should('not.have.focus');

    cy.get('[data-testid="search-input"]').type('test query');
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-input"]').should('have.value', 'test query');
  });

  it('should not focus search input when other keys are pressed', () => {
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-input"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-input"]').should('not.have.focus');

    // Press a different key (e.g., "a")
    cy.get('body').type('a');

    // Assert search input is still not focused
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-input"]').should('not.have.focus');

    // Verify the key press did not populate the search input
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-input"]').should('have.value', '');

    // Now press "/" and verify focus works
    cy.get('body').type('/');
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-input"]').should('have.focus');
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

Return ONLY the raw Cypress JavaScript — no markdown fences, no explanations. Include describe(), beforeEach(), and at least 2 it() blocks (happy path + edge case).</SYSTEM>
<USER>User story: "As a user, I want to exclude a term from search by prefixing it with '-'."
Category: search_filter
Complexity: medium
Return the script only.</USER>
<ASSISTANT>describe('Search Filter - Exclude Term with Minus Prefix', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    cy.visit('/search');
    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/search*').as('searchRequest');
  });

  it('should exclude results containing the prefixed term from search results', () => {
    // User enters a search query with exclusion term
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-input"]').type('javascript -tutorial');
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-button"]').click();

    // Wait for API call and verify exclusion parameter
    cy.wait('@searchRequest').then((interception) => {
      expect(interception.request.url).to.include('exclude=tutorial');
    });

    // Verify results page loads
    cy.get('[data-testid="results-container"]').should('be.visible');

    // Verify that results contain 'javascript' but not 'tutorial'
    cy.get('[data-testid="result-item"]').each(($item) => {
      cy.wrap($item).should('contain', 'javascript');
      cy.wrap($item).should('not.contain', 'tutorial');
    });

    // Verify result count is displayed
    cy.get('[data-testid="result-count"]').should('be.visible').should('contain', 'results');
  });

  it('should not exclude terms when minus prefix is not used or term is empty', () => {
    // User enters search without exclusion term
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-input"]').type('python');
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-button"]').click();

    // Wait for API call and verify no exclusion parameter
    cy.wait('@searchRequest').then((interception) => {
      expect(interception.request.url).not.to.include('exclude=');
    });

    // Verify results are returned normally
    cy.get('[data-testid="results-container"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="result-item"]').should('have.length.greaterThan', 0);

    // Test edge case: only minus sign without term
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-input"]').clear().type('java -');
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-button"]').click();

    // Verify search is treated as regular query without exclusion
    cy.wait('@searchRequest').then((interception) => {
      expect(interception.request.url).not.to.include('exclude=');
    });

    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('not.exist');
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

<ASSISTANT>describe('Search Results - Highlighted Search Terms', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    cy.visit('/search');
  });

  it('should highlight search terms in result snippets - happy path', () => {
    // Setup: intercept search API
    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/search*').as('searchResults');

    // Perform search
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-input"]').type('cypress automation');
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-button"]').click();

    // Wait for API response
    cy.wait('@searchResults');

    // Verify search results are displayed
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-results"]').should('be.visible');

    // Verify highlighted terms in first result
    cy.get('[data-testid="result-snippet-0"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="result-snippet-0"] [data-testid="highlighted-term"]')
      .should('contain', 'cypress')
      .should('have.css', 'background-color');

    // Verify second term is also highlighted
    cy.get('[data-testid="result-snippet-0"] [data-testid="highlighted-term"]')
      .eq(1)
      .should('contain', 'automation');

    // Verify multiple results have highlights
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-results"] [data-testid="highlighted-term"]')
      .should('have.length.greaterThan', 2);

    // Verify highlight styling is consistent
    cy.get('[data-testid="result-snippet-1"] [data-testid="highlighted-term"]')
      .should('be.visible')
      .should('have.css', 'font-weight', '700');
  });

  it('should handle edge case with no matching terms to highlight', () => {
    // Setup: intercept search API
    cy.intercept('GET', '/api/search*').as('searchResults');

    // Search with special characters and very specific term

    cy.get('[data-testid="search-button"]').click();

    cy.wait('@searchResults');

    // Verify results container still displays
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-results"]').should('be.visible');

    // Verify no highlighted terms exist when search yields no matches
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-results"] [data-testid="highlighted-term"]')
      .should('not.exist');

    // Verify "no results" message is shown
    cy.get('[data-testid="no-results-message"]')
      .should('be.visible')
      .should('contain', 'No results found');

    // Clear and verify search input is cleared
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-input"]').clear();
    cy.get('[data-testid="search-input"]').should('have.value', '');
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

<USER>User story: "As a screen reader user, I want all images to have descriptive alt text."
Category: accessibility
Complexity: medium
Return the script only.</USER>
<ASSISTANT>describe('Image Alt Text Accessibility', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    cy.visit('/gallery');
  });

  it('should display all images with descriptive alt text for screen reader users', () => {
    // Verify main hero image has alt text
    cy.get('[data-testid="hero-image"]')
      .should('be.visible')
      .should('have.attr', 'alt')
      .and('not.be.empty');

    cy.get('[data-testid="hero-image"]')
      .invoke('attr', 'alt')
      .should('contain', 'product');

    // Verify gallery images all have descriptive alt text
    cy.get('[data-testid="gallery-item"]').each(($img) => {
      cy.wrap($img)
        .should('be.visible')
        .should('have.attr', 'alt')
        .and('not.be.empty');

      cy.wrap($img)
        .invoke('attr', 'alt')
        .should('match', /^[a-zA-Z0-9\s\-,]+$/);
    });

    // Verify carousel images have alt text
    cy.get('[data-testid="carousel-image"]').each(($img) => {
      cy.wrap($img)
        .should('have.attr', 'alt')
        .and('not.be.empty');
    });

    // Test alt text is descriptive (not just "image" or "pic")
    cy.get('[data-testid="product-showcase"]')
      .invoke('attr', 'alt')
      .should('have.length.greaterThan', 5);
  });

  it('should fail validation when images are missing alt text', () => {
    // Intercept accessibility audit API
    cy.intercept('POST', '/api/accessibility-audit').as('auditRequest');

    // Click audit button
    cy.get('[data-testid="run-audit-button"]').click();

    cy.wait('@auditRequest');

    // Verify missing alt text is reported
    cy.get('[data-testid="audit-results"]')
      .should('be.visible')
      .should('contain', 'missing alt text');

    // Verify specific images are flagged
    cy.get('[data-testid="audit-failure-item"]')
      .should('have.length.greaterThan', 0)
      .first()
      .should('contain', 'alt attribute');

    // Verify error count is displayed
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-count"]')
      .should('contain', 'violations');
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

    // Verify live region container exists

    cy.get('[data-testid="live-region"]').should('have.attr', 'aria-live', 'polite');

    // Verify announcement is hidden from visual display but available to screen readers
    cy.get('[data-testid="live-region"]').should('have.class', 'sr-only');

    // Verify role is properly set for accessibility
    cy.get('[data-testid="live-region"]').should('have.attr', 'role', 'status');

    // Run accessibility checks
    cy.checkA11y('[data-testid="live-region"]', {
      rules: {
        'aria-required-attr': { enabled: true },
        'aria-valid-attr-role': { enabled: true }
      }

    cy.get('[data-testid="content-container"]').should('contain', 'Updated');

  it('should handle missing live region and alert when screen reader announcements cannot be made', () => {

    cy.get('[data-testid="live-region"]').then(($region) => {

    });

    // Attempt to trigger content update
    cy.get('[data-testid="refresh-data-button"]').click();

    cy.get('[data-testid="live-region"]').should('not.exist');

    cy.checkA11y(null, {

    // Wait for timeout response
    cy.wait('@paymentTimeout');

    // Assert redirect to error page
    cy.url().should('include', '/payment-error');
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-title"]').should('be.visible');
    cy.get('[data-testid="error-message"]').should('contain', 'Payment processing timed out');
